title: 第1500章 破桎梏空间本源第1499章 剑界缠绕千层丝
content_zh:
林玄猛然睁开双眼。
他的气息在这一刻疯狂暴涨。
顶级战圣的桎梏被悍然冲破，直接踏入初等战皇层次！
“原来如此。”
林玄低声自语。
七阶寂灭青冥剑魄的突破，让他对毁灭剑意的理解达到了一个全新的境界。这种力量不再是单纯的破坏，而是一种规则层面的“终结”。
终结万物。
终结一切。
千层丝在他身上仍旧紧紧缠绕，可那些蛛丝正在一根根崩解。
不是被斩断。
而是被剑意从存在层面直接“抹除”。
林玄握住九劫剑，剑身上的黑色剑纹已经彻底凝固，宛如天然生就的纹路。
他看向周围那些再次扑上来的火晶兽。
一千五百余只。
方才那一波爆发，直接斩杀了百余只，但残存的火晶兽依旧密密麻麻。
不过，已经构不成威胁了。
林玄踏前一步。
墨黑剑域随之扩展，从一丈暴增至十丈！
踏入剑域的火晶兽，晶化身躯直接开始崩解。赤红色的晶石从边缘开始剥落、粉碎，仿佛被无形的力量侵蚀。
扑通、扑通！

一具具失去生命气息的晶化残骸坠落在地。
林玄没有停留。
他身形一闪，朝着骷海圣逃离的方向追去。
青冥剑翼在背后展开，速度瞬间飙升。
三里距离，数息即至。
骷海圣正在飞速逃窜。
他背后光翼震动频率达到了极致，身形几乎化作一道流光。
可林玄的速度更快。
初等战皇级别的修为催动青冥剑翼，再加上剑域加持，林玄整个人如同一柄黑色飞剑，撕裂空间。
“骷海圣。”
冰冷的声音从身后传来。
骷海圣瞳孔猛缩，头也不回地投出一柄战矛。
那战矛通体银白，矛尖有圣级铭文闪烁，破空时发出刺耳的音爆。
林玄随手一剑斩出。
黑色剑罡如瀑布般倾泻。
战矛与剑罡碰撞的瞬间，矛身上的圣级铭文疯狂闪烁，试图抵御。
但下一瞬——
咔嚓！
战矛从矛尖开始寸寸碎裂。
七阶寂灭青冥剑意沿着战矛蔓延而上，将铭文、材质、乃至其存在的痕迹一同抹除。

骷海圣脸色骤变。
那柄战矛虽然不是他最强的宝物，但也是中等圣级的攻击型秘宝，居然连林玄一剑都挡不住？
他猛然转身，身上的铠甲绽放出耀眼光芒。
那是他最大的依仗——中等圣级防御铠甲“银鳞玄甲”！
可林玄的剑已经斩落。
content_en:
Lin Xuan suddenly opened his eyes.
His breath surged wildly at this moment.
The shackles of the top war saint were smashed through, and he stepped directly into the junior war king level!
"That's it."
Lin Xuan whispered to himself.
The breakthrough of the seventh-level Nirvana Sword Soul brought his understanding of the Destruction Sword Intent to a whole new level. This power is no longer pure destruction, but an "end" at the rule level.
End all things.
End everything.
Thousand layers of silk were still tightly wrapped around his body, but those threads were disintegrating one by one.
Not cut off.
Instead, it was directly "erased" from the level of existence by the sword's will.
Lin Xuan held the Nine Tribulations Sword. The black sword patterns on the sword had completely solidified, just like natural patterns.
He looked around at the fire crystal beasts that were rushing towards him again.
More than 1,500.
The wave of explosions just now killed more than a hundred of them, but the remaining fire crystal beasts were still densely packed.
However, it no longer poses a threat.
Lin Xuan took a step forward.
The black sword domain expanded accordingly, from one foot to ten feet!
The crystal body of the fire crystal beast that stepped into the sword domain immediately began to disintegrate. The crimson crystals began to peel and shatter from the edges, as if being eroded by invisible forces.
Thump, thump!
The crystallized remains that lost their life breath fell to the ground.
Lin Xuan did not stop.
He flashed and chased in the direction where Skeleton Sea Saint fled.
Qing Ming's sword wings spread out behind his back, and his speed surged instantly.
Three miles away, we'll be there in a few breaths.
The Skeleton Sea Saint is running away quickly.
The vibration frequency of the light wings behind him reached the extreme, and his body almost turned into a stream of light.
But Lin Xuan was faster.
The cultivation of the junior war emperor level activated the Qingming sword wings, coupled with the blessing of the sword domain, Lin Xuan's whole body was like a black flying sword, tearing apart the space.
"Skeleton Sea Saint."
A cold voice came from behind.
The Skeleton Sea Saint's pupils shrank sharply, and he threw a war spear without looking back.
The war spear was completely silver-white, with holy inscriptions flashing on the tip of the spear, and it emitted a harsh sonic boom when it broke through the air.
Lin Xuan slashed out with his sword.
The black sword gang poured out like a waterfall.
The moment the war spear collided with the sword, the holy inscriptions on the spear flashed crazily, trying to resist.
But the next moment——
Click!
The war spear began to shatter inch by inch from the tip of the spear.
The seventh-level Nirvana Qingming Sword Intent spreads along the war spear, erasing the inscriptions, materials, and even traces of its existence.
Skeleton Sea Saint's expression suddenly changed.
Although that war spear is not his most powerful treasure, it is also an offensive secret treasure at the mid-level saint level. It can't even block Lin Xuan's sword?
He turned around suddenly, and the armor on his body burst into dazzling light.
That is his biggest support - the medium holy level defensive armor "Silver Scale Black Armor"!
But Lin Xuan's sword had already been cut down.
